name: almanac-validation-v1
frozen: 2026-11-06, before any ALMANAC dose-level model run. Architectures, optimization, features and seeds are copied from the ONEIL sprint without change: f0_combined (selected in 5/5 ONEIL folds) and f2_combined (declared in docs/neural_results.md as the configuration to confirm, with interpolation for absent monotherapy doses). Nothing is selected on ALMANAC; validation fold (f+1)%5 only stops training.

f2_combined.purpose: all architecture/optimization changes with interpolated monotherapy

selection.scope: single frozen candidate per regime; no choice is made

comparisons: training-pair monotherapy on top of identities and doses
network vs the fixed Bliss rule on the same training-pair monotherapy
identities and doses vs the fixed Bliss rule
network vs additive ridge on the same inputs
secondary: pair-cell contrast R2 and interaction residual R2 beyond Bliss with drug-jackknife intervals
ONEIL-trained frozen networks are not applied to ALMANAC: only 14 drugs and 9 cells overlap and the targets differ (see report)
verdict_rule: as in the ONEIL sprint: lower error only if the pair-bootstrap and drug-jackknife intervals, every fold and every seed pairing agree
